content:
IVX BANK-GRADE SECURITY + CERTIFICATION EXECUTION ORDER

You are authorized to continue the IVX Holdings Platform remediation END TO END on the CURRENT FEATURE BRANCH ONLY.

DO NOT:
- Do not merge to main without explicit owner authorization.
- Do not weaken, bypass, skip, delete, or game any security/QA gate.
- Do not manufacture 112/112 results.
- Do not grant engineering/code tools to research-only agents just to improve a score.
- Do not mark anything CERTIFIED unless the exact same commit SHA passed the required gates.
- Do not untrack legitimate source files merely to make secret_scan green.
- Do not expose credentials, hashes, JWT secrets, service-role keys, bank account/routing numbers, PII, financial summaries, wire submissions, or audit data.
- Do not introduce third-party banking/payment beneficiaries or alternate wire destinations.
- Never print secrets in logs, reports, screenshots, artifacts, or certificate files.

CURRENT PRIORITY: BANK-GRADE PRIVACY / MEMBER AUTH / WIRE SECURITY

1. FIRST READ CURRENT REPOSITORY STATE
   - git status
   - current branch
   - current HEAD SHA
   - PR state
   - changed files
   - current CI state
   - do not overwrite unrelated work

2. VERIFY AND PRESERVE THESE DATABASE SECURITY REQUIREMENTS
   The Supabase production database has been emergency-hardened. Repository code must preserve the same contract permanently:

   AUTH / SQL / WALLET:
   - public.ivx_query_auth_user_by_email(text):
       EXECUTE = postgres + service_role ONLY
       NO PUBLIC
       NO anon
       NO authenticated
       fixed search_path
   - public.ivx_exec_sql(text):
       service-role/backend only
       NO PUBLIC / anon / authenticated
   - public.atomic_wallet_operation(...):
       service-role/backend settlement only
       NO PUBLIC / anon / authenticated
       fixed search_path
   - member clients must NEVER self-credit wallet balances
   - deposits/wires must NEVER create balance until verified server-side settlement
   - client-side direct ledger writes must remain blocked

   MEMBER DATA:
   - investor_profiles:
       RLS enabled
       anon = zero access
       authenticated member can SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE only where member_id = auth.uid()
       no client DELETE/TRUNCATE
   - member_financial_summary:
       RLS enabled
       anon = zero access
       authenticated member = SELECT own row only
       NO client writes
   - classification_audit:
       backend/service_role only

   WIRE / DURABLE DATA:
   - ivx_durable_documents and ivx_durable_events:
       RLS enabled
       PUBLIC/anon/authenticated = zero table access
       service_role only
   - wire submissions/reports must never be publicly readable
   - full wire instructions must never be returned to unauthenticated users
   - unauthenticated landing can show only a generic bank-name/sign-in preview
   - routing/account/beneficiary details only after valid authenticated authorization

3. SECURITY DEFINER AUDIT
   Audit ALL public SECURITY DEFINER functions.
   For every function:
   - classify as:
       A. legitimately public and safe
       B. authenticated-user safe
       C. service-role/backend only
   - revoke PUBLIC/anon/authenticated EXECUTE wherever not explicitly required
   - set a safe immutable search_path where appropriate
   - do not break required public landing analytics/chat behavior
   - produce exact before/after grants as evidence

4. AUTHENTICATION E2E
   Prove BOTH landing/web and Expo/mobile flows:
   - member registration
   - email validation behavior
   - sign in
   - invalid password rejection
   - missing/expired session rejection
   - authenticated session restoration
   - sign out
   - no other member can read another member's profile or financial summary
   - anonymous user cannot access member financial data
   - direct-auth emergency fallback must remain service-role only and must never expose encrypted_password outside the backend process

5. WIRE BANK E2E
   Verify:
   - public visitor receives NO routing number/account number/full beneficiary
   - authenticated member can retrieve authorized wire instructions
   - wire destination is exclusively the configured IVX-controlled wire beneficiary/account
   - scan entire repository for alternate:
       routing numbers
       account numbers
       beneficiary names
       payment recipients
       crypto addresses
       Stripe/PayPal/payment redirects
       external wire providers
       hardcoded third-party bank destinations
   - any unexpected destination = HARD FAIL and remediate
   - wire submission validates amount/reference/sentAt
   - submitting a wire does NOT automatically credit a wallet
   - wallet credit only occurs through verified server-side settlement
   - wire reports/audit evidence remain private

6. SECRET SCAN — FIX CORRECTLY
   For every flagged tracked file:
   - identify whether it contains:
       real secret
       historical real secret
       fake/test fixture
       documentation example
       regex/signature false positive
   - real credentials: remove from Git-tracked content and rotate/revoke if exposed
   - test fixtures: replace with runtime-generated deterministic fixtures or explicit safe placeholders
   - historical/transcript files: sanitize sensitive values before deciding whether tracking is appropriate
   - DO NOT simply untrack 89 files to force green unless each file is independently proven to be generated/private evidence that must not live in Git
   - prove zero actual credentials remain in tracked HEAD

7. REPAIR THE AUDIT INSTRUMENT
   qa/ivx-112-senior-audit.ts must NOT automatically fail every agent merely because changedFiles is empty.
   But it also must NOT automatically pass them.

   Correct contract:
   - research-only role can pass its ROLE-SPECIFIC evaluation without producing code
   - engineering-capable role must demonstrate appropriate engineering evidence
   - role verification and senior-developer certification are separate metrics
   - do not claim all 112 are senior developers unless all 112 truly satisfy the same engineering benchmark
   - preserve rejection tests:
       out-of-scope tool
       prohibited tool
       unauthorized write
   - no hardcoded "everyone passes"
   - no hardcoded "everyone fails"

8. BUILD A REAL ENGINEERING EVALUATION SUITE
   For engineering-capable agents, create reproducible benchmark tasks including:
   - bug diagnosis
   - safe code modification
   - tests
   - TypeScript correctness
   - security/privacy reasoning
   - auth/access-control task
   - database/RLS task
   - regression prevention
   - error handling
   - evidence provenance
   - no fake outputs

   Report separately:
   - role-verified agents
   - engineering-capable agents
   - engineering-certified agents
   - research-only agents
   Never collapse those into a fake 112/112 engineering score.

9. REGRESSION TESTS REQUIRED
   Add tests that fail if any future commit:
   - grants anon access to ivx_query_auth_user_by_email
   - grants anon/authenticated access to ivx_exec_sql
   - grants member clients atomic_wallet_operation
   - disables RLS on investor_profiles/member_financial_summary
   - permits cross-member data access
   - exposes full wire instructions publicly
   - allows client-side wallet credit
   - adds alternate/hardcoded wire beneficiary
   - leaks service-role/JWT/bank secrets
   - changes the audit back to hardcoded pass/fail logic

10. RUN FULL QUALITY GATES ON THE EXACT FINAL SHA
   Required:
   - secret scan
   - backend TypeScript
   - Expo TypeScript
   - lint
   - backend unit tests
   - Expo unit tests
   - security/privacy regression tests
   - Playwright web E2E
   - mobile Maestro E2E if runner available
   - Supabase security advisor
   - explicit SQL privilege verification
   - registration/sign-in E2E
   - wire E2E
   - wallet settlement safety tests

11. COMMIT
   Commit only the necessary files on the existing feature branch.
   Use a clear commit message, for example:
   fix(security): enforce bank-grade member and wire privacy

12. FINAL REPORT MUST BE EVIDENCE-ONLY
   Return:
   - exact Git commit SHA
   - exact files changed
   - exact DB permissions verified
   - exact RLS policies verified
   - registration tests PASS/FAIL
   - sign-in tests PASS/FAIL
   - cross-member isolation PASS/FAIL
   - public wire privacy PASS/FAIL
   - authenticated wire flow PASS/FAIL
   - wallet self-credit prevention PASS/FAIL
   - secret scan PASS/FAIL
   - TypeScript PASS/FAIL
   - unit tests PASS/FAIL
   - Playwright PASS/FAIL
   - Maestro PASS/FAIL/QUEUED
   - Supabase advisor remaining ERROR/WARN findings
   - PR state
   - production deployment state
   - exact production SHA if deployed

CERTIFICATION RULE:

CERTIFIED = TRUE only if every REQUIRED gate above has actually executed and passed on the exact same final SHA and production is proven to serve that SHA.

If any required gate is queued, skipped, unavailable, stale, failing, or has no evidence:
CERTIFIED = FALSE / UNVERIFIED.

Do the work now. Do not stop after analysis. Do not give me a narrative instead of execution.
